zones.name: TO DO
zones.subtitle: On the Workboard
zones.description: This is the realm of listening. Here, the material dreams in silence. Ideas circle gently around it—waiting, watching, breathing. Before the hand moves, the soul prepares.
zones.atmosphere: A space of anticipation where raw materials hold infinite possibility.

hotspots.title: Raw Materials
hotspots.description: Untouched aerial roots rest here, each holding the promise of transformation. In this quiet space, the sculptor observes and listens before the first touch.

hotspots.title: The Workboard
hotspots.description: Ideas and sketches gather here—visual whispers of what might become. This is where intention takes its first visible form.

zones.name: DO NOT
zones.subtitle: The Silent Watch
zones.description: Some strength lies in restraint. Some beauty lives in boundaries. In this chapter, the sculptor chooses not to force, but to protect the essence of what might become.
zones.atmosphere: A space of discipline where knowing what not to do is as important as action.

hotspots.title: Tools in Rest
hotspots.description: Shadowed tools hanging neatly in a row. Each tool knows its purpose, and each knows when to remain still. Restraint is a form of respect.

hotspots.title: Boundaries of Creation
hotspots.description: Not every idea must be pursued. Not every material must be touched. This space honors the wisdom of choosing carefully.

zones.name: DOING
zones.subtitle: Being Sculpted
zones.description: Here, creation finds its pulse. Material and maker enter a tender conversation—every strike, every curve, a dialogue between intention and revelation.
zones.atmosphere: The heart of transformation where hands and vision meet.

hotspots.title: The Sculpting Process
hotspots.description: Motion—chisel dust rising, material yielding. Each movement is deliberate, each cut a conversation. The sculpture emerges not by force, but through listening.

hotspots.title: Work in Progress
hotspots.description: A form taking shape, revealing itself slowly. The sculptor follows the material's guidance, discovering rather than imposing.

zones.name: DONE
zones.subtitle: Crafted to Completion
zones.description: A moment of settled breath. The work stands complete—balanced, quiet, whole. Not an ending, but a place where nothing more needs to be touched.
zones.atmosphere: Stillness and completion. The sculpture has found its final form.

hotspots.title: Completed Sculpture
hotspots.description: The work stands complete, glowing with presence. Every curve, every surface speaks of the journey from raw material to finished form.

hotspots.title: Final Inspection
hotspots.description: A quiet moment of observation. The sculptor steps back, ensuring nothing more is needed. Completion is knowing when to stop.

zones.name: OUTDONE
zones.subtitle: Legendary
zones.description: Some works step beyond the studio's walls and enter the realm of legend. They hold stories larger than their shape, echoing time long after the tools are laid to rest.
zones.atmosphere: Where masterpieces transcend their physical form and become timeless.

hotspots.title: Signature Masterpiece
hotspots.description: A dramatic presentation of work that has achieved legendary status. This sculpture carries a presence that extends beyond its material form.

hotspots.title: Legacy Display
hotspots.description: Works that have defined the studio's voice. These pieces represent not just skill, but the culmination of vision, patience, and artistic truth.

zones.name: OUTCOMES
zones.subtitle: Living Beyond the Studio
zones.description: The journey continues—new eyes, new emotions, new stories. Every viewer finishes the sculpture in their own heart. This is where art becomes life.
zones.atmosphere: The beginning of a new chapter as sculptures find their homes and stories.

hotspots.title: Gallery Placement
hotspots.description: Sculptures placed in galleries and homes, beginning their new lives. Each piece now belongs to those who connect with it, continuing its story.

hotspots.title: Collector Connections
hotspots.description: The relationship between artwork and viewer. Here, the sculpture's journey transforms from creation to connection, from studio to soul.
